name: the two download buttons carry the measured size
every stablemate link and both downloads resolve
eval: (async function(){var a=[].slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('a[href]')).map(function(x){return x.getAttribute('href')}).filter(function(h){return h && h.indexOf('http')!==0 && h.indexOf('#')!==0});var seen={},out=[];for(var i=0;i<a.length;i++){if(seen[a[i]])continue;seen[a[i]]=1;try{var r=await fetch(a[i],{method:'GET'});if(r.status!==200)out.push(a[i]+' -> '+r.status);}catch(e){out.push(a[i]+' THREW');}}return Object.keys(seen).length+' distinct links, '+(out.length?('BROKEN: '+out.join(', ')):'all 200');})()
